blocks.title: Smart contract
blocks.text: Smart contract blockchain par digital muahida hai jo khaas sharait poori hone par apni shartein khud amal mein lata hai, darmiyani khatam kar ke ghaltiyan aur dhoka kam karta hai.

Ethereum jaise platforms developers ko maaliyat, supply chains, jaidad aur insurance ke liye smart contracts se decentralized applications (DApps) banane dete hain. Flight insurance ka contract flight late hone par khud adaigi kar sakta hai. Smart contracts shaffaf hain aur un ka chalna blockchain yaqeeni banata hai, magar inhein be-ghalti code aur tanazaat hal karne ke qanooni nizam chahiyein.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain 2.0 mein smart contract kya hai (MCQ 18; short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: (b) khud chalne wala contract jis ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hain. Code ki sharait poori hon, maslan adaigi mili aur milkiyat tasdeeq hui, to yeh baghair darmiyani ke khud chal jata hai.

items: Smart contracts: khud nafiz hone wala code (flight late insurance); be-ghalti code aur qanooni sahara chahiye.
